author: CollinRugg
text:
Dr. Tomasz Kosowski cross-examines lead detective Colin Bolton, asks him to walk him through exactly how he allegedly killed attorney Steven Cozzi

Kosowski: Once I dumped the body, I went home to Miami. Correct?

Bolton: Correct

Kosowski: Did I act alone?

Bolton: It appears so
